Verified License Seal · Directions & Workbook

A working exploration of the TIS-issued Verified License credential seal (per brand/components.md §Seal · Standalone). Two candidate directions are shown first, each built for all four issuers so TIS reads alongside partners NYCU · IPIC · III. Direction 1 is a round seal; Direction 2 seats the same woven-moiré interior inside the TIS submark (diamond-cube) silhouette. The Workbook below keeps the earlier variants and dead-ends that led here, so the process stays visible.
Colour carries issuer identity (TIS #252525 · NYCU · IPIC · III). Every badge is a self-contained <svg>, downloadable as a true SVG or a transparent @2x PNG. Latin text embeds Urbanist on export.

Direction 1

Woven moiré · circular seal

The round woven-moiré credential seal, built for all four issuers so TIS reads alongside partners NYCU · IPIC · III.

Direction 2

TIS submark shell · woven-moiré interior

The submark (diamond-cube) silhouette wrapping the round woven-moiré interior — all four issuers in the cube shape, recoloured per issuer.

English

中文

Direction 3

Sheen & shine · struck metal disc

The Direction-1 circular seal given a real surface to catch light: a brushed silver disc behind the artwork, a specular band drifting across it, and a key light that follows the cursor. Geometry and issuer colour are untouched — the metal is a CSS ground behind the <svg>, not part of the mark.

English

Surface, sweep and key light are all document CSS, so none of it survives cloneNode — SVG and PNG exports carry the flat issuer-coloured seal on transparency, exactly as Direction 1. Hover a seal to move its key light; sweeps are staggered so the row ripples rather than pulsing in lockstep.

Workbook

Process & exploration

The earlier variants and dead-ends behind the two directions above — kept to show the process.

Circle seal · logo centre (reversed)

Direction-1 circular seal (TIS, English) with the TIS submark in the centre in place of the "TIS" letters. Reversed treatment (transparent medallion, logo over the moiré). TIS uses its submark; partners shown with their own logo — illustrative only, pending permission to use each mark.

Row 2 · No count

Bottom-arc count stripped. Top-arc org line + center logo retained.

Compare

Ring weight · both at 3.0 · 中文

Chinese counterpart of the 3.0 banded design. Both rings stroke-width 3; centre band = full Chinese name (Noto Sans TC); bottom cap = 有效期至 (label / date). Partner ZH names are DRAFT — verify.

Explore

Guilloché · inner motif round 2 (rope edge, TIS)

The two favourites (sunburst, dense rosette) on TIS, plus two more: a woven moiré of two overlaid spirographs, and an interlocking-circles rosette (flower-of-life petals).

Shapes

Shape exploration — broken inner circle (faceted medallion)

Inner circle broken to match the silhouette: the medallion + framing ring become the polygon, keeping both guilloché patterns (moiré inner, rope outer). Two takes each — round moiré vs moiré clipped to the polygon — on octagon and the TIS cube.

Shapes

Shape exploration — circular medallion + split validity

Faceted outer silhouette with a circular medallion for the initials (round moiré inside). Title follows the top facet edges; VERIFIED LICENSE dropped — VALID THROUGH sits on the bottom-left face, the date on the bottom-right face.
